json.reason: The respondent gave up instantly on multiple interactive tasks without any attempt, and completed the entire survey in under a third of the time the rest of the group needed. These are classic indicators of bad faith: giving up immediately and not attempting the tasks.
json.panel_text: You left every interactive task immediately without trying (for example, you gave up after 4 seconds when others took about 1 minute), and finished the whole survey in 2 minutes when most people needed 9 minutes. This means your answers cannot show genuine effort or attention.
